class: An editor opened from one item (one trade) that writes a record shared by others: the clicked item is unchanged while items that have no copy yet, and all future ones, change.
mechanism: 'Customise triggers' opened the shared rule set; a trade that already holds its own copy never reads it again.

first_seen.evidence: The clicked trade (own copy) was NOT changed; trades with no plan yet and all future plans were.

fix: New routes edit the trade's own plan body only; closed trades are refused.

detection.note: Unguarded: no named check is confirmed to cover the class; the proof was one real run, not a standing check.

occurrences.evidence: The clicked trade (own copy) was NOT changed; trades with no plan yet and all future plans were.
